text: V1 ships one bounded test: pick 4 of 12 assets, maximize return minus risk, benchmarked against a classical brute-force baseline over all 495 combinations.
What's deferred, not dropped: a production trading system, and scaling to Meridian's real, multi-thousand-asset universe.
That real universe is flagged honestly as likely infeasible on near-term quantum hardware, regardless of how this V1 study turns out.
V1 also doesn't promise quantum advantage as a conclusion before the comparison actually runs.
Next: choosing the stack -- Qiskit, Aer, and real IBM Quantum hardware.
